# clickcast

> Playwright browser automation, screenshots and GIF/MP4/WebP recording for AI agents. Every run returns a demo reel plus a machine-readable JSON sidecar (schema v5) with per-step selectors, timing, console errors, page state and structured action deltas. A live MCP server exposes the same engine for step-by-step agent control.

clickcast drives Chromium, Firefox or WebKit through Playwright. Batch mode records a whole tour and writes `<reel>.json` next to it; live mode (MCP) drives one action at a time and returns a bounded payload per call.

## Install

```bash
pip install clickcast
pip install 'clickcast[mcp]'   # MCP server
npx -y clickcast-mcp           # same MCP server without a Python install
clickcast install              # download browser engines
```

## Batch: record a tour, read the sidecar

```bash
clickcast auto https://example.com --out tour.gif
clickcast run tour.yml --emit-events --out tour.gif
clickcast elements https://example.com
clickcast explore https://example.com
clickcast assertions tour.gif.json --baseline baseline.json
clickcast diff tour.gif.json baseline.gif.json
clickcast report-bug tour.gif.json --json
clickcast doctor --json
```

`auto`/`run` write two files: the reel (`tour.gif`) and the sidecar
(`tour.gif.json`). Gate on `steps[].status` (`ok` / `failed` / `skipped`),
`steps[].error_code`, `steps[].skip_reason` and `steps[].delta` instead of
parsing prose.

## Python API

```python
from clickcast import AsyncReel, Reel, discover

Reel("https://example.com", viewport=(1280, 800), fps=12) \
    .goto(wait="networkidle") \
    .click("#cta", label="Open pricing") \
    .save("tour.gif")

reel = Reel("https://example.com").goto()
snapshot = reel.observe(token_budget=800)   # observe/1 payload, ref=eN handles
summary = reel.receipt(out="./artifacts")   # receipt/1 payload + artifact dir
```

- `Reel.observe()` / `AsyncReel.observe()` — token-bounded page snapshot with stable `ref=eN` handles
- `Reel.receipt()` — one artifact directory plus a <=200-token summary
- `discover(url)` — list interactive elements without recording
- `Reel.serve_dir("./public")` — serve a local directory for the tour

## MCP server (live agent control)

```bash
clickcast mcp
```

Tools: `start_session`, `close_session`, `goto`, `click`, `dblclick`,
`hover`, `type`, `press`, `select`, `scroll`, `wait`, `screenshot`,
`observe`, `settle`, `receipt`.

Action tools accept `ref` (an `eN` handle from `observe`) in place of
`selector`. Every action returns a `delta` describing what changed.

## Perception loop

`observe -> act -> settle -> receipt`

| Call | Question it answers | Ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| `observe` | What can I act on? | 800 est. tokens, 20 nodes |
| act (`click(ref=...)`) | What did it change? | 300 est. tokens |
| `settle` | Has the page stopped changing? | `timed_out` is reported, never hangs |
| `receipt` | Did it work, and where are the artifacts? | 200 est. tokens |

## Sidecar schema

Current version: **v5**, strictly additive from v1. `steps[].delta` is
optional and `null` on batch runs, so v1-v4 sidecars parse unchanged.

- [v5 JSON Schema](https://github.com/AlexKay28/clickcast/blob/main/src/clickcast/feedback/schema/v5.json)
- [Feedback schema doc](https://alexkay28.github.io/clickcast/feedback-schema.html)
